code:
import json

# Write file
with open("students.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write("Alice\n")
    f.write("Bob\n")
    f.write("Carol\n")

# Read file
print("File contents:")
with open("students.txt", "r") as f:
    for line in f:
        print(" ", line.strip())

# JSON
data = {"name": "Alice", "age": 21, "courses": ["CS101", "CS201"]}
json_str = json.dumps(data, indent=2)
print("\nJSON String:\n", json_str)

parsed = json.loads(json_str)
print("\nParsed name:", parsed["name"])
print("Courses:", parsed["courses"])

title: Exception Handling
List Comprehensions and Generators
code:
import itertools

nums = range(1, 11)

# List comprehension
squares = [x**2 for x in nums]
print("Squares:", squares)

# Filtered comprehension
evens = [x for x in nums if x % 2 == 0]
print("Evens:", evens)

# Dict comprehension
sq_dict = {x: x**2 for x in range(1, 6)}
print("Square dict:", sq_dict)

# Set comprehension
unique = {x % 5 for x in range(20)}
print("Unique remainders mod 5:", unique)

# Generator
def fibonacci_gen():
    a, b = 0, 1
    while True:
        yield a
        a, b = b, a+b

fib = fibonacci_gen()
print("First 10 Fibonacci:", [next(fib) for _ in range(10)])
